# @mod-internal/ui page templates

Complete, working screens built with the library: sign-in, sign-up, verification, password reset, error and status pages, dashboards, settings, informational pages and emails. Start a new screen from the closest template instead of from an empty file: open its file in `templates/` and adapt it. Every template works in Arabic and English and from desktop to mobile.

## Dashboards 01

| Template | File | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Reports dashboard (Directorate) | `templates/dashboards-01--reports-dashboard.md` | Change the period to reload the figures, sort the table by its headers, collapse the side bar with the button beside the logo, and switch to the tablet or mobile width to get the side bar as a drawer. The language button in the top bar works too. |

## Dashboards 02

| Template | File | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Coordinator home (Hospital) | `templates/dashboards-02--coordinator-home.md` | Press “Take action” on a case: it leaves the queue, the saved message appears, the counters (tile, header button, side bar badge) go down and the activity gets a new entry. Filter the queue by required action, confirm an appointment's attendance, and switch to the mobile width to get the side bar as a drawer. |

## Forgot password pages

| Template | File | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Request reset | `templates/forgot-password-pages--1-request-reset.md` | Asks for the email address or user name of the account. Try an empty submit, or a value such as “a b”, to see the validation. The confirmation does not reveal whether the account exists. |
| 2. Check your email | `templates/forgot-password-pages--2-check-your-email.md` | Confirms that the instructions were sent to a masked address. Resend is disabled for 30 seconds after each send. |
| 3. Set new password | `templates/forgot-password-pages--3-set-new-password.md` | The page the emailed link opens, shown as a card. The strength bar and the checklist update while typing, and the button is enabled only when every rule is met. Try “Referral#2026”. |
| 4. Password changed | `templates/forgot-password-pages--4-password-changed.md` | The success state that ends the flow and leads back to the log in page. |

## Log in pages

| Template | File | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Split with image (Default) | `templates/login-pages--split-with-image.md` | The default: the sign-in of a hospital referral portal. Form on the start side, brand panel with the image, process icons and system name on the end side. Try an empty submit, or the password “wrong”. |
| Centered | `templates/login-pages--centered.md` | One narrow column: the emblem, the heading and the form, with “Remember me” and “Forgot password?” in one row and a link to sign up. For systems that do not need a brand panel. Try an empty submit, or the password “wrong”. |
| Centered card | `templates/login-pages--centered-card.md` | The same content inside a bordered card on the gray page background (the card and muted options of the auth layout). |
| Split, panel on the start side | `templates/login-pages--split-panel-on-the-start-side.md` | The brand panel comes first and has no photo: a solid dark-green panel with the system name and three points about what the system does. On narrow screens the panel becomes a banner above the form. |
| With single sign-on | `templates/login-pages--with-single-sign-on.md` | Credentials form as the primary action, then a divider and a secondary button for the national single sign-on, with a notice about the lockout rule. Use the password “wrong” to see the remaining attempts count down; the fifth failure locks the form. |

## 404 sections

| Template | File | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Simple centered (Default) | `templates/not-found-sections--simple-centered.md` | A small status label, the title, one sentence of help and two actions. Use it inside an existing page shell. |
| Large code | `templates/not-found-sections--large-code.md` | The status code as a large watermark number above the title. The number scales with the width of the section. |
| With search and helpful links | `templates/not-found-sections--with-search-and-helpful-links.md` | Helps the user continue: a search box and the three most useful destinations. Type a query and press Enter to see the demo answer. |
| Split with illustration | `templates/not-found-sections--split-with-illustration.md` | Text on the start side and an inline SVG illustration in the brand colours on the end side. Stacks into one column on narrow screens. |
| Dark | `templates/not-found-sections--dark.md` | The brand dark green as a full-height background, for standalone pages outside the application shell. |
| Other statuses | `templates/not-found-sections--other-statuses.md` | The same section for 403 (no permission) and 500 (something went wrong). Use the switch inside the preview to change the status. |

## Sign up pages

| Template | File | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Centered | `templates/signup-pages--centered.md` | Full name, email and password in one narrow column. The checklist under the password ticks each rule as it is met; the terms must be accepted. Leave a field or submit to see the errors. |
| Split with image | `templates/signup-pages--split-with-image.md` | The same form next to the brand panel with the image, so sign-up matches the default sign-in page. |
| Multi-step | `templates/signup-pages--multi-step.md` | Three steps in a card with the progress indicator: Account, Organisation (region dropdown and role radio group) and Review. Next validates only the current step; Back keeps what was typed. |
| Request access | `templates/signup-pages--request-access.md` | For internal systems without self sign-up: the employee sends national ID, employee number, work email, department and a reason, and an administrator approves the request. The panel explains what happens next. |

## Verification pages

| Template | File | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Email code | `templates/verification-pages--email-code.md` | Centered page with a 6-digit code. Verify is enabled when all boxes are filled, and Resend is disabled for 30 seconds after each send. Try the code 000000 to see the error state; any other code succeeds. |
| SMS code | `templates/verification-pages--sms-code.md` | Card with four large boxes and no submit button: the code is checked as soon as the fourth digit is entered. Try 0000 to see the error state; any other code succeeds. |
| Split with image | `templates/verification-pages--split-with-image.md` | The second step of the default sign-in: the 6-digit code, grouped three and three, next to the image panel. Try 000000 to see the error state. |
| Link sent and verified | `templates/verification-pages--link-sent-and-verified.md` | Verification by link instead of a code. Use the switch above the page to see its two states: the link was sent (open the email app, resend), and the page the link opens once the address is confirmed. |
